command-rockpile-desc: Convert stone piles between vanilla and Acervus Lapidum
command-rockpile-convert-desc: Turn nearby vanilla stone piles into rock piles. Pass a radius in blocks (default 32), or 'all' for every loaded chunk.
command-rockpile-revert-desc: Turn nearby rock piles back into vanilla stone piles. Run this before removing the mod. Pass a radius in blocks (default 32), or 'all' for every loaded chunk.
command-rockpile-badradius: Radius must be a number from 1 to {0}, or 'all'.
command-rockpile-converted: Converted {0} stone pile(s) holding {1} stone(s), across {2} loaded chunk(s).
command-rockpile-reverted: Reverted {0} rock pile(s) holding {1} stone(s), across {2} loaded chunk(s). Stones a vanilla pile could not hold were dropped on the ground.
blockinfo-rockpile-full: Full — place a stone on top to start the next course
blockinfo-rockpile-solid: Solid — you can build on this
blockhelp-rockpile-add: Add a stone (hold to keep adding)
blockhelp-rockpile-layout: Choose the layout, or turn the pile
heldhelp-rockpile-place: Place a stone (hold to keep placing)
heldhelp-rockpile-layout: Choose the layout, or turn the pile
